item.title: Spokane Arts - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: Throughout our partnership with Spokane Arts over the past several years, we have had an incredible experience producing video interviews that highlight the stories of some of the most talented and generous artists in our community.

item.title: Pullman Arts Foundation - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: We are proud to share this heartwarming project, which stands as a testament to the strength of community and the ongoing efforts to inspire change through art.

item.title: Women Helping Women Fund - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: It was an honor to attend and capture the Women Helping Women Fund's "Give Like a Woman" event, where community members came together to support local organizations through grant funding.

item.title: Measure Meant - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: Our collaboration with Measure Meant showcases their innovative work, from engaging documentaries to professional portraits, all capturing their mission to inspire change and promote sustainable business practices.

item.title: Spokane Salmon Release - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: In collaboration with Spokane Tribal Fisheries, we had the privilege of capturing the multi-tribal Chinook salmon release at People’s Park.

item.title: Transitions - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: The stories captured for the 30th anniversary of the Women's Hearth was such an experience, and it was a thrill to hear from those closest to the stories, that our work did justice to the people and the legacy therein.

item.title: Inland Northwest Land Conservancy - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: Through collaboration with INLC and their partners, we produced a powerful film that highlights the vision for Glen Tana's permanent protection.

item.title: Water Wise Spokane - Collaborating for Resource Stewardship
item.description: This multifaceted campaign is geared to energize residents towards sustainable habits at home, and to promote free incentives and resources that make a measurable impact on local water use - Water Wise Spokane has been going strong since 2019!

item.title: Manzanita House - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: Manzanita House's inspiring work to empower immigrants and refugees through legal aid and whole family support strengthens our community.

item.title: Spokane Climate Project - Rogue Heart Media
item.description: Watch the 30-minute updated KSPS PBS special of "Spokane Climate Project," now licensed to stream on PBS Passport! 🌎
